```{=html}
<span id="hysteresis-explorer" aria-hidden="true"></span>
<div class="teaching-demo" id="fan-control" data-demo="fan-control" role="region" aria-labelledby="fan-demo-title">
  <div class="demo-heading"><div><p class="demo-eyebrow">Try it · Temperature and a fan</p><h3 id="fan-demo-title" class="unnumbered">Turn the fan on and off</h3></div><button type="button" data-fullscreen hidden>Enlarge demo</button></div>
  <p>Choose when the fan turns on and off. Then move the temperature slider.</p>
  <div class="sensor-workbench">
    <div class="sensor-inputs">
      <div class="sensor-control"><label for="fan-temperature">Temperature (°C)</label><input id="fan-temperature-number" type="number" aria-label="Temperature, degrees Celsius" min="0" max="50" step="0.1" value="27"><input id="fan-temperature" type="range" min="0" max="50" step="0.1" value="27"></div>
      <div class="sensor-control"><label for="fan-on">Turn on at (°C)</label><input id="fan-on-number" type="number" aria-label="Turn the fan on at, degrees Celsius" min="28" max="50" step="0.1" value="30"><input id="fan-on" type="range" min="28" max="50" step="0.1" value="30"></div>
      <div class="sensor-control"><label for="fan-off">Turn off at (°C)</label><input id="fan-off-number" type="number" aria-label="Turn the fan off at, degrees Celsius" min="0" max="30" step="0.1" value="28"><input id="fan-off" type="range" min="0" max="30" step="0.1" value="28"></div>
      <p id="fan-rule" class="sensor-rule">Turn on at 30.0°C or warmer. Turn off at 28.0°C or cooler.</p>
      <button type="button" id="fan-clear">Clear graph</button>
    </div>
    <div class="sensor-results">
      <div class="fan-card" id="fan-card"><p>Fan</p><strong id="fan-state">OFF</strong><span id="fan-status" role="status">27.0°C: the fan is off.</span></div>
      <figure class="demo-plot sensor-plot"><svg id="fan-plot" viewBox="0 0 640 320" role="img" aria-labelledby="fan-plot-title fan-plot-description"><title id="fan-plot-title">Temperature and fan on or off</title><desc id="fan-plot-description">The fan is off at 27 degrees Celsius.</desc><g id="fan-axes"></g><g id="fan-traces"></g></svg><figcaption><span>Blue: temperature</span><span>Green: fan on · empty: fan off</span></figcaption></figure>
      <p class="demo-note" id="fan-history-note">Reading 1.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="demo-note">Changing the settings or clearing the graph starts again. The fan starts off unless the temperature is already high enough to turn it on. You control the temperature in this demo.</p>
  <div class="demo-footer"><span>Move the temperature up and down to see what happens.</span><button type="button" data-reset>Reset</button></div>
  <noscript><p>Enable JavaScript to use the controls. The example turns the fan on at 30°C and off at 28°C.</p></noscript>
</div>
```
